notes: the gloss «- وهو ابن أبي كثير -» is left out, so the fourth link stands as written: «يحيى»
«معاوية» is a bare name as written; it is not completed
Abu Bakra is the Companion whose words («نهانا رسول الله») end the chain

fixes.reason: The lexicon attaches Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyan, who died 60 AH, to the link that takes the report from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, who died 132 AH.
